description: Request that a company be added to Trackly's tracked companies. Use when the user asks about a company that isn't in trackly_search_companies / trackly_list_companies results. Rate-limited to 5 pending requests per user.

companyUrl.description: Optional careers page or homepage URL (e.g. "https://careers.ebay.com")

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

notes.description: Optional context (e.g. "MBA hiring page", "specific role I want tracked")

name: trackly_request_company
